title: Small-etale restriction and canonical tensor comparison on algebraic-space tests
statement:
Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $p:\mathcal C\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ a category fibred in groupoids, with its big fppf structure ringed site [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra, def-pc-fppf-site]. Let $K$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an algebraic space $V/S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], let $\mathcal S_V$ denote its discrete fibred category: objects over $T$ are maps $v:T\to V$, and an arrow from $v':T'\to V$ to $v:T\to V$ is a scheme map $h:T'\to T$ satisfying $vh=v'$. A based test is a functor $z:\mathcal S_V\to\mathcal C$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$. Restrict $z$ to the small-etale scheme charts of $V$. Define the module sheaf $K_z$ on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ by $K_z(T,v)=K(z(v))$, with restriction along $h$ equal to $K(z(h))$. Its action is the original action after identifying $\mathcal O_V(T,v)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)=\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}(z(v))$ by the common base scheme. On a module morphism $\lambda:K\to L$ define $(\lambda_z)_{(T,v)}=\lambda_{z(v)}$. Use module sheaves in the ambient universe, without imposing quasi-coherence.

Let $a:V\to W$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces, let $w:\mathcal S_W\to\mathcal C$ be a based test, and let $\theta:z\Rightarrow w\circ\mathcal S_a$ be a natural isomorphism over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, where $\mathcal S_a(T,v)=(T,av)$. Use the chart-limit direct image $a_*$, tensor pullback $a^*$, specified adjunction unit and local tensor sections of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], with composition normalization [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition]. Define $d_{a,\theta}^K:K_w\to a_*K_z$ by its chart projections: for an etale chart $(E,e)$ over $W$, a chart $(T,v)$ over $V$, a map $r:T\to E$ with $er=av$, and $m\in K_w(E,e)$, put
$$\pi_{T,r}\bigl(d_{a,\theta}^K(E,e)(m)\bigr)=K\bigl(w(r)\circ\theta_{(T,v)}\bigr)(m).$$
Here $\theta_{(T,v)}:z(v)\to w(av)$ lies over $\mathrm{id}_T$, so the composite arrow has source $z(v)$ and target $w(e)$. The displayed compatible family defines $d$ by the limit universal property. Define the canonical comparison $c_{a,\theta}^K:a^*K_w\to K_z$ to be the adjoint of $d_{a,\theta}^K$. Equivalently its value on the local tensor associated with this chart is
$$b\otimes m\longmapsto b\,K\bigl(w(r)\circ\theta_{(T,v)}\bigr)(m),\qquad b\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T).$$
Retain this chart arrow and the identity natural isomorphism $\mathrm{id}_z$ as part of the based-test notation. This defines the comparison without imposing its later naturality, composition or invertibility properties. No quasi-coherence, stack, algebraicity of $\mathcal C$, flatness or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q46-3a3b69228 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the delivered definition in full and compared it with the base text in clones/live. The rewrite makes the same construction explicit: S_V is the discrete fibred category; z and w are based tests; theta: z => w∘S_a has components over id_T; d: K_w -> a_*K_z has chart projections pi_{T,r}(d(m)) = K(w(r)∘theta_T)(m); and c is the adjoint of d. The old 'theta_T;w(r)' is the same arrow written in composition order. Nothing is weakened. The only citer, lem-sfb-fibred-fppf-space-module-comparisons, stays consistent. The construction agrees with stacks-sheaves.tex lines 1465-1510: c_varphi is the adjoint of the unit restricted to the space, with the 2-cell identification, and the module version is Tag 076R. Direction a^*K_w -> K_z and O_{V_et}-modules match the source. Checked against the cited statements: def-trf-space-etale-module-functors (chart category A(a,E), limit projections, adjoint unit, local tensor b⊗m), def-trf-algebraic-space (O_V(T) = Gamma(T,O_T)) and def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra (fppf site on any fibred category, discrete fibred category of a space). Dropping def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module and def-pc-module-pullback is justified. Checked by hand that the definition is well defined: K_z is a sheaf (étale chart covers lie over fppf covers, and fibre products are preserved because C is fibred in groupoids; this is the existing lemma lem-sfb-fibred-fppf-ringed-inverse-image, so there is no cycle); the family is compatible by naturality of theta; it is linear over r^#; it is natural in E; and the b⊗m formula follows from the unit and determines c. Edge cases: K=0; identity test with theta=id (gives ordinary restriction); V empty; a nontrivial vertical theta; non-étale a, where c is not claimed invertible. Grepped the DAG for 076R: only lemmas mention it, and no definition node duplicates this one. Mathlib verdict null is correct. No SGA source used.
